_meta.scope: Vendors tab: Type G checks on shipped vendor rows (skip/vendors.json) and Type N vendor milestones dated after 2026-11-13 that skip/news.json lacks, including unlisted 1-20 MWe designs. Radiant and Aalo-X excluded per recently-checked.md.
angles_run: Type G valar-ward250 first_delivery_target (fetched ANS 2026-10-05, NPR/WLRN 2026-09-30)

Type G status search: antares, westinghouse evinci, bwxt-banr, general-atomics-ga-tes, oklo-aurora (searched; no dated post-11-13 vendor event and no fetched page contradicting shipped text, so no check written)
Type N search: Valar, Antares Mark-1, eVinci, Deployable Energy Unity, NANO KRONOS, Last Energy PWR-20, Terra Innovatum SOLO, Natura MSR-1, Blue Energy, Steady Energy LDR-50
Keyword cross-check of skip/news.json for vendor events dated 2026-09-19 to 2026-11-13
absences: No vendor milestone dated after 2026-11-13 surfaced for any listed vendor or unlisted 1-20 MWe design in 15 searches. Searches for Antares, eVinci, Deployable, NANO KRONOS, Last Energy, Natura, Blue Energy and Terra Innovatum returned nothing newer than their October-2026 items, several of which are already in skip/news.json.

Terra Innovatum (not a shipped vendor row): company said NRC Safety Evaluations of its SOLO topical reports were expected by October 2026. One search found no published SER. The October target has passed; current status unverified and no record written.

Valar Project Beehive (Utah): no BLM completeness or NEPA determination found after the NPR article of 2026-09-30, which says the BLM is 'reviewing the application for completeness'. The Utah Trust Lands Administration Board lease approval of 2026-09-17 is not a standalone item in skip/news.json; it is dated 62 days before capture, outside the 60-day window, so not written.

Steady Energy EIB EUR 40M loan: skip/news.json dates it 2026-09-15. One search summary said October 2026. A fetched Steady Energy article (oenergetice.cz, dated 2026-02-23) does not mention the loan, so neither date was verified. No record written.
Deployable Energy Utah MOU (2026-08-18) and Hornbeck MOU: dated outside the 60-day window and not in skip/news.json. Not written.

Blue Energy and Natura: search results show no microreactor-scale vendor milestone in the window. Blue Energy's work is light-water SMR gas-plus-nuclear; Natura's FLiBe salt delivery is already in skip/news.json dated 2026-09-22 (search summary said arrival 2026-09-18; not checked further, news lane).

checks.evidence: Ward 250 delivery is still not published. The ANS article of 2026-10-05 gives Valar's Project Beehive timeline (first reactors online in 2028) and no Ward 250 delivery date. NPR, via WLRN dated 2026-09-30, gives the same 2028 target for the Beehive campus near Price, Utah. Beehive is a separate proposed campus, not the test reactor, and the row does not carry that 2028 target.

sources.label: ANS — Details emerge on Valar's Utah plans (2026-10-05)
sources.quote: Valar aims to begin nonnuclear construction by the end of this year and to have first reactors on line in 2028.
